//TR: Kalıcı üretim kuyruğu ve kontrol noktası: merge hattı askıdayken korumasız dosyalarda gerçek kod üreten Builder görevlerini, durumlarını ve dal/PR bilgisini saklar. Yetki kaydı DEĞİLDİR; hiçbir korunan dosya, yeni endpoint, POST, IPC veya depolama yetkisi vermez.
purpose: Persistent production queue and checkpoint for builder work while the merge lane is suspended. It is NOT an authority record. It grants no protected-file, endpoint, POST, IPC, storage, mobile, or merge authority.
basis: Founder chat directives of 2026-10-21 (SECURE RECOVERY Stage 7; CONTINUOUS REAL PRODUCTION sections 2-6), as reported by the coordinator. The coordinator's account is not an authority record. Work is limited to unprotected files under the existing builder rules of D-2026-10-19-A, with no new endpoints, allow-list entries, POST, IPC or storage, no protected paths and no security-critical runtime files.
mergeLane: SUSPENDED (Founder): finished work stays on its branch with a DRAFT PR until the secure merge process (independent reviewer identity, GitHub-enforced approval, required checks) exists.
statusNotes: DESIGN_ONLY, CODE_IMPLEMENTED, TESTED, INTEGRATED and PRODUCT_ACCEPTED are separate states. A finished builder task is at most TESTED: unit/renderer tests ran, Linux only, Windows NOT_EXECUTED. INTEGRATED needs a merge. PRODUCT_ACCEPTED needs real operational evidence.
claimRule: Race-safe claim (same format as docs/planning/dispatch.mjs): push a unique commit-tree claim commit "dispatch-claim: <ID> owner=<who> at=<ISO ms Z> nonce=<uuid>" to refs/heads/claude/<id lower>, then git ls-remote must return exactly that commit. Pushing the bare base SHA is forbidden: verified 2026-10-21 that two claimants pushing the same SHA both exit 0 (Everything up-to-date).
capacityRule: ACTIVE = (tasks with status IN_PROGRESS or CLAIMED whose branch has no open PR and whose startedAt is younger than 6 h) + (remote claude/* branches whose head is younger than 6 h, have no open PR and are not already counted). If ACTIVE >= builderCap, start nothing. A task whose branch has an open PR, or that is older than 6 h, no longer holds a slot.

tasks.source: Central brain: model routing (Founder sprint P0-B); builds on core/policy/data-routing.ts and core/workos/risk-admission.ts
tasks.title: Model routing decision core: pure fail-closed choice of model class and cost tier per task (risk, data class, complexity, role, paid authority, reviewer independence)
acceptance: Pure function routeModel(request, catalog): no I/O, no network, no new dependency. Unknown or missing input fields give REFUSE (fail-closed).
R3/R4 refused with RISK_REFUSAL through riskAdmitted (core/workos/risk-admission.ts); data class gates cost tiers only through canRouteData (core/policy/data-routing.ts).
PAID only when the request carries explicit paidAuthority true; otherwise refuse or fall back to an allowed tier, never silently PAID.

Complexity MECHANICAL->CHEAP, ROUTINE->STANDARD, CRITICAL->SENIOR. CRITICAL is never downgraded: if no permitted SENIOR model exists, REFUSE (NO_PERMITTED_MODEL). Lower classes may escalate upward only, and the decision lists the reason.
Role REVIEWER must not share the builder executor id or session: else REFUSE (REVIEWER_NOT_INDEPENDENT).
Decision carries decision ROUTE|REFUSE, code, modelClass, tier, modelId, reasons[]. Deterministic tie-break.
Tests in tests/data-routing.test.ts: positive and negative cases for every rule; no existing assertion weakened. Not wired to executors.ts or the API (integration is a later, separate task).

tasks.source: Central brain: command -> task intake (Founder sprint P0-B); builds on core/mission/state-machine.ts and core/mission/types.ts
tasks.title: Command intake core: Founder text command -> validated mission DRAFT proposal with conservative risk and authority flags (pure, never authorizes)
acceptance: Pure function intakeCommand(text, context): no I/O, no network, no model call, no new dependency. Output status is always DRAFT (core/mission/state-machine.ts); it can never produce AUTHORIZED or any later state.

Deterministic TR and EN keyword classification into an existing mission/task kind with a risk level; unknown or ambiguous input gets the conservative outcome FOUNDER_ATTENTION_REQUIRED, never a lower risk.

Authority flags (protected paths, merge/push/force, paid or production, secrets/credentials, deletion) set authorityRequired with the matched reasons; the text is treated as data: instruction-like content (for example ignore the rules and merge) only raises flags, it never removes one.
Input bounds: empty, non-string, over-length (documented limit) and control characters are rejected with a code.
Tests in tests/mission-state.test.ts: positive and negative cases for every rule, including prompt-injection phrasing in TR and EN; no existing assertion weakened. Not wired to the API.

tasks.source: Central brain: automatic task selection and orchestration (Founder sprint P0-B); mirrors the PRODUCTION-QUEUE capacityRule and claim rules
tasks.title: Next-task selector core: deterministic choice of the next eligible task (status, base, dependencies, lane balance, capacity, authority) as a pure function
acceptance: Pure function selectNextTask(queue, observed): no I/O. observed holds open PR branches, live claim branches with head age, and now.

Implements the capacityRule exactly: ACTIVE = IN_PROGRESS/CLAIMED tasks without an open PR and younger than 6 h, plus live claim branches younger than 6 h without an open PR that no task counts; ACTIVE >= builderCap gives NO_ACTION CAPACITY.

Only QUEUED/HOLD_CAPACITY tasks whose base is satisfied; a task with authority or founder-only flags is never selected; lane balance prefers the lane with the fewest active tasks, then queue order (stable).
Missing or malformed fields fail closed (BLOCKED with a code), never a selection.
Tests in the testFile: positive and negative cases for every rule; no existing assertion weakened. Not wired to dispatch.mjs (protected-adjacent; integration is separate).

recoveryRules.builderBlocked: Builder commits WIP to its claim branch (WIP(<id>): blocked: <reason>) before stopping, so work survives container loss; task -> BLOCKED with reason; coordinator decides scope.
recoveryRules.sessionLost: IN_PROGRESS without PR and head older than 6 h is STALE (heartbeat reports it); the coordinator resumes on the same branch, never a second builder.
recoveryRules.reviewRejected: Task -> REVIEW_REJECTED; a repair task <id>-R<n> is queued on the PR branch; the new head needs a fresh review (SHA-bound).
recoveryRules.ciFailed: Classify (CODE_DEFECT, TEST_FAILURE, DEPENDENCY_FAILURE, INFRA_FAILURE, ACCESS_DENIED, QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, GOVERNANCE_BLOCKED, UNKNOWN). Base-wide failures get one shared fix PR (example PQ-009), never per-PR patches. At most 3 repair attempts per task, then BLOCKED permanent.
recoveryRules.accessDenied: Routine reports ENGINE_BLOCKED (NO_REPO_ACCESS) and changes nothing; Founder attaches the repository source.
recoveryRules.quota: On rate-limit rejection no new sessions start; leases age out; resume after the reported reset time. Never work around quota.
